title: Integrating temporal placebo diagnostics into FastAPI and Swagger
text: Responsible. It prompts further investigation. I implemented causal_temporal_placebo.py. It constructs future engagement within each SKU, then estimates the impossible direction as an independent reliability check. Future engagement is accepted only for the same SKU on exactly the next calendar day. A later observation across a date gap is not treated as consecutive. The placebo model adjusts for prior sales, prior engagement, inventory availability, SKU fixed effects, and day of week effects. Inventory constrained observations are excluded where the appropriate flag is available. The procedure checks required variables, temporal order, and sample adequacy. An inadequate sample returns insufficient {underscore} data instead of an unreliable estimate. Observation and SKU counts provide transparency. The architecture connects the primary adjusted effect to uncertainty, shuffled placebo testing, temporal falsification, overlap, stock out analysis, model robustness, and observational evidence reporting. Each challenges a different weakness. The existing evidence score was intentionally left unchanged. The temporal placebo is reported separately, preserving the score's established meaning while making the new diagnostic visible. A relatively small placebo relationship is more reassuring. A large relationship suggests temporal structure, confounding, common trends, or specification issues may remain. Neither result is an automatic causal verdict. Passing does not prove causality or validate the causal diagram. Failing does not automatically invalidate the primary estimate. The diagnostic was documented and integrated successfully in the fast API and Swagger environment.
